name: Potentially Suspicious Windows App Activity
description: Detects potentially suspicious child process of applications launched from inside the WindowsApps directory. This could be a sign of a rogue ".appx" package installation/execution
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate packages that make use of external binaries such as Windows Terminal
query: process.parent.executable:*C\:\\Program\ Files\\WindowsApps\\* AND ((process.executable:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\wscript.exe)) OR (process.command_line:(*cmd\ \/c* OR *Invoke\-* OR *Base64*))) AND (NOT (process.parent.executable:*\:\\Program\ Files\\WindowsApps\\Microsoft.WindowsTerminal* AND process.parent.executable:*\\WindowsTerminal.exe AND (process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe))))
